name: ipa-mcp
description: The department's microscopes, protocols, PSF and laser-power records, from your synced copy of the site's library
long_description: Lets your assistant answer questions about the UNIGE Biochemistry imaging site: which scope has a water objective, whether a laser has lost power since last year, where the PSF of an objective is, what is installed on the lab VMs, where to book. It reads the OneDrive-synced copy of the site's library on your machine, read-only, with no credentials. Experimental.

library.title: Synced library folder
library.description: The folder OneDrive created when you clicked Sync on the site's library, named 'biochem-ipa - Documents'. Leave empty to let the server find it.

tools.name: ipa_status

tools.name: ipa_set_user

tools.name: ipa_equipment
